services.heading: How it works
services.sub: Every enquiry gets qualified automatically, and nobody gets dropped.
services.step1Desc: A short survey for parents to answer, plus an area to upload any research they may have already conducted.
services.step2Desc: A profile is built from their answers and uploads, then scored 0-100 in real time and sorted into Hot (70-100), Warm (40-69), or Cold (0-39) automatically.
services.step3Desc: Hot leads book straight onto your calendar, and every lead is prioritised hot to cold, so you and your team know exactly who to follow up with first each day for the best chance of admission.
